title: Kition kit index (kits-index.json)
description: Every kit the `kition` command line can install: per kit its id, display name and file extensions; per version the Kit Process Protocol it speaks and, per platform, its archive (a .tar.gz with kit.json and the kit's executable at its top) with size and SHA-256. `kition` reads exactly the `schemaVersion` it was built for and asks to be upgraded for a newer one. See kition-sdk's docs/sdk/cli.md.

schemaVersion.description: The index format. A change that an older kition would misread raises it.

kits.description: Each kit by its short name: `note` for `kit.note`.

id.description: The kit.json `id`: `kit.` and the short name.

extensions.description: The extensions it edits (kit.json formats with role `edit`), lowercase, without the dot.

versions.description: Each published version, by its semver.

protocol.description: The Kit Process Protocol the executable speaks, as its kit.json says (`headless.protocol`). kition installs only a version that speaks its own.

platforms.description: The archive for each platform: darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-arm64, linux-x64 (glibc), win32-x64.

ui.description: The version's editor package, the same for every platform: a .tar.gz (the kit repository's Release asset kition-<kit>-<version>.tgz) holding one folder <kit>-ui/ with the editor's index.html, its engine and fonts, and the kit's kit.json. kition installs it beside the headless kit (kits/<kit>/ui/<version>/) and kition gateway serves it to its editor page. Absent for a version published without one.

url.description: An https address, or a path; a relative one is read beside the index.
